newsitem.title: GERMANY: Heidelberger Zement - 97 profit to match 96.
newsitem.headline: Heidelberger Zement - 97 profit to match 96.

text.p: German building materials group Heidelberger Zement AG said on Tuesday it was aiming for 1997 profits to match 1996 levels.
The firm earlier reported a rise in 1996 net profits to 502 million marks from 469 million previously.

Heidelberger's chief executive Rolf Huelstrunk told a news conference that while 1997 profits were likely to be at 1996's levels, both operating results and cash flow were sure to rise again this year.
In 1996, Heidelberger's cash flow rose 10.5 percent to 1.2 billion marks.
But Huelstrunk added that the firm would probabaly also have to reckon with high interest and tax expenditure in 1997.
Heidelberg also said that in the first quarter of this year, sales had risen 15 percent on a year earlier.
